core_job: This spec is the "if kept" path; retiring RideZap into TripNest (D1) is the founder's call. The user is someone in a US city who takes the same Uber or Lyft trips again and again. They save a trip once: real places from the Photon (OpenStreetMap) search, with distance and drive time without traffic from FOSSGIS OSRM. 'Check fares' then opens Uber and Lyft with both ends filled in by coordinates. When the user comes back to RideZap, a keypad asks what each app quoted. Any quote can become a logged ride (paid amount, tip, Work or Personal tag). Everything is stored on the phone. RideZap shows no provider prices because it has no fare API.
signature: 'Your usual' fare check. It is a personal baseline per trip, per service and per time-of-day band (same weekday/weekend type, ±90 min, at least 3 fares, median and p25–p75), built only from quotes and receipts the user entered, including past rides backfilled from receipts. Each new quote gets a verdict: High at +20% or more, Low at −10% or less, otherwise Typical. A 'right now' line says which app is lower when both were logged within 10 minutes. After 5 fares, the trip shows the user's own fares plotted by hour of day. Competitors were checked through the iTunes API only, because WebSearch is disabled. Obi (id1081008679) shows live prices but no personal history in its description. FairFare (id6761694835) does not mention history. FareWise (id6804430468) puts ride history behind a $4.99/month subscription. None describes judging a quote against your own history for that trip at that time of day.
must: M1 One build, nothing hidden (the 5.6 fix): delete the RIDEZAP_API_* switches in env.dart, the HTTP/no-live price sources, the hidden watch-list tab (router.dart:138 visibleBranches), the results, quote detail and saved screens, and flight/hotel/Expedia/Booking/Bolt. Pass if: grep fromEnvironment finds only AglAdIds; the banned strings grep is 0 in lib/ and in the release App.framework strings; the app never reads Remote Config

M2 Core job: places from Photon search and trips with cached OSRM distance. Check fares opens Uber (m.uber.com/ul) and Lyft (www.lyft.com/ride) with both ends filled in, through LinkLauncher. The quote keypad appears on return to the app and also from a visible 'Log a quote' button. Parsers are tested on real recorded fixtures; link builders are unit-tested

M3 Signature: a pure usual_fare.dart module (time band rules, 3-fare minimum, +20%/−10% verdicts, p25/p75 from 5 fares, one currency per baseline, no double counting) plus the verdict card, the 'right now' comparison and the hour-pattern CustomPainter. Every rule is unit-tested, and a widget test covers backfill feeding a High verdict

M4 Depth: 'I took this' turns a quote into a ride; past rides can be backfilled from receipts. Rides log has search, filters by service/tag/month, swipe-to-undo and monthly totals per service and tag. CSV copy uses Clipboard (share_plus is blocked by the dirty Podfile.lock). Data is versioned in shared_preferences and survives relaunch. Offline, routing-failure and 429/5xx states are designed; no spinner runs forever

M5 Own identity: home is a 'Your trips' board with no tab bar and exactly one AglAdBanner (trip page), and no interstitial. Two-card onboarding, shown once. Hand-built 'Kerbside receipt' palette: ink #22304F, high-fare vermilion #B23A1A, low-fare teal #1E7268, surface #F4F5F2, plus dark-mode values, with contrast asserted by tests. Fonts bundled: Big Shoulders and Schibsted Grotesk (google_fonts removed). 4 px receipt shapes with perforated edges. Hand-made icon (generator line 77 removed). New splash with a shasum different from 3f6a9b27

M6 Honest copy: remove 'No live prices', 'yet' apologies, 'Where prices come from', 'Booking links', the affId tag and the gateway footer. Settings becomes one short page: How it works, OpenStreetMap/Photon/OSRM attribution with a fix-the-map link, defaults, appearance, language, Privacy choices, delete everything, and the version read from the build. Empty states written in this app's voice; 'cheapest', 'coming soon', 'sample' and 'demo' are banned

M7 Proven: flutter analyze is clean and every test passes (baseline 349, all green). New tests cover every M1–M6 behaviour plus the identity checks. Tests are deleted only together with the gateway, flight and hotel code they test, and each is named in the commit. Layout, i18n and widget tests are rewritten, not dropped. Launch on the simulator and screenshot the app. Commit path-limited, never fastlane/, Podfile.lock or project.pbxproj
